params.body:
## Summary

Two things the site needs before the domain switches.

- **The old URLs keep working.** A catch-all route at the end of `routes/web.php` sends the paths of the previous site to the new ones with a 301, in all five languages: the category pages (`/sales/voertuig-zoeken-{categorie}.html`, `sales.php?p=…`, German `fahrzeugsuche-…`), the vehicle pages (`…_Detailansicht_{id}.html`; the DMS id is our `external_id`, a vehicle that is gone goes to the stock), the company and contact pages, `/aankoop` in its translations, and the legal pages. Unknown paths still give a 404. Mapping in `App\Site\Legacy`, with the patterns documented at the top.
- **Privacy and cookies page** at `/privacy`: who we are (company, VAT, address), what the site stores and why (requests, the origin of a visit in the session, server logs), retention, who receives data (hosting, mail, Google only after consent), the cookie table (session, CSRF, consent choice, Google Analytics, Google Ads) with a link to reopen the cookie choice, and the rights with the Belgian authority. Linked from the footer and from the banner, in the sitemap, `noindex`. Dutch text with translated headings.

Retention periods in the text (24 months for requests, 30 days for logs) are proposals for Schoutteet to confirm.

Tests: 4 new (category, detail, company and legal redirects; privacy page, footer and sitemap). Suite: 44 tests.

## After merge

Deploy; nothing else. The redirects only matter once the domain points to this site.
